newsitem.title: INDIA: State-run Central Bank of India cuts prime rate.
newsitem.headline: State-run Central Bank of India cuts prime rate.

text.p: State-run Central Bank of India said on Friday it will cut its prime lending rate to 14.5 percent per annum from 15 percent with effect from May 1.
The revised rate is exclusive of interest tax, a bank statement said.
"The maximum spread will be four percentage points over the prime rate for advances other than consumer credit," it said.
The bank also said it will reduce its interest on post-shipment export credit to 12.5 percent per annum from 13 percent for credit up to 45 days.
